title: About Us
content:
About Us


FTimerbet is a digital-first sports betting and casino brand built for the modern Nigerian player. We are an online-only platform, licensed by the Oyo State Gaming Board, offering a simple, intuitive and rewarding way to bet from anywhere, anytime—no retail shop required.

Our focus is clear: fast access, fair odds, and a smooth experience from registration to cashout. Whether you’re backing your favourite team, exploring virtuals, or enjoying casino games, FTimerbet is designed to keep things easy to understand and quick to use.


What We Offer



  • Online-only convenience – Bet directly from your phone, tablet, or laptop without visiting a physical shop.
  • Sports, virtuals & casino – From top football leagues and major events to number games and slots, you’ll find a wide range of markets and games to choose from.
  • Live & pre-match markets – Place bets before kick-off or jump into the action with live betting as the game unfolds.
  • Flexible bet options – Singles, multiples, and a variety of special markets to suit different styles of play.


Safe, Secure & Transparent

We know trust is everything in betting. FTimerbet uses reputable payment partners and industry-standard security measures to protect your data and your money. Transactions are processed securely, and your account activity is monitored to keep your experience safe and compliant with Nigerian regulations.

Payouts are processed directly to your bank account, and we are committed to handling withdrawals in a clear and transparent manner—no hidden stories, no confusion.


Our Approach to Players

FTimerbet is built around the Nigerian player—your habits, your devices, your preferred payment methods, and your love for the game. Our customer support and operations are locally driven, so communication is simple, direct, and relatable.

We also support responsible gaming by encouraging players to set personal limits, take breaks when needed, and treat betting as entertainment—not a way to solve financial problems.

At FTimerbet, every click should feel straightforward, every bet should be clear, and every win should be easy to access. That’s the standard we hold ourselves to, every day.

title: Privacy Policy
content:
Privacy Policy – Ftimerbet


This Privacy Policy explains how Ftimerbet (“Ftimerbet”, “the Company”, “we”, “us”, or “our”) collects, uses, stores, and protects information about users (“you”, “your”, or “users”) when you access and use our strictly online betting services in Nigeria.

By creating an account or using our website/platform, you agree to the collection and use of your information in line with this Privacy Policy and applicable Nigerian data protection laws. Please read it carefully.


1. Collection and Use of Information

1.1 Personal Information

To provide and manage our online betting services, we may collect the following types of personal information:



  • Full name
  • Residential address
  • Email address and phone number
  • Date of birth and gender
  • Identity verification details (e.g. ID number, BVN where applicable)
  • Financial and payment information (e.g. bank details, card details, wallet IDs)
  • Login and authentication details (username, password, security information)

We use this information to:



  • Create, verify, and manage your Ftimerbet account
  • Process deposits, withdrawals, and other transactions
  • Comply with legal and regulatory obligations in Nigeria (e.g. KYC, AML/CFT, responsible gaming requirements)
  • Personalise your betting experience and show relevant offers
  • Communicate with you about your account, security, promotions, and updates
  • Analyse customer behaviour to improve our products, services, and platform performance


1.2 Technical & Usage Information

When you access our website or use our services, we may automatically collect technical data such as:



  • IP address
  • Browser type and version
  • Device type and operating system
  • Access times and pages viewed
  • Referral URLs and clickstream data

This information is collected through cookies, log files, and similar technologies. We use it to:



  • Improve website and app functionality and user experience
  • Monitor performance and diagnose technical issues
  • Detect and prevent fraud, abuse, and suspicious activities
  • Enhance the security and stability of our online platform


1.3 Information from Third Parties

We may receive information about you from:



  • Payment providers and financial institutions
  • Verification and fraud-prevention services
  • Affiliates, marketing partners, and service providers

We ensure such third parties are subject to appropriate privacy and security obligations. We may combine this information with data collected directly from you to:



  • Complete KYC/verification checks
  • Prevent fraud, bonus abuse, and multiple-accounting
  • Improve our risk management and service offerings


2. Legal Basis for Processing (Nigeria)

Where applicable, we process your personal information based on one or more of the following legal grounds:



  • Performance of a contract: To create and manage your Ftimerbet account and provide our betting services.
  • Legal obligation: To comply with Nigerian laws and regulatory requirements (e.g. anti-money laundering, responsible gaming, tax, data protection).
  • Legitimate interest: To improve our services, prevent fraud, protect our business, and ensure platform security, provided such interests do not override your rights.
  • Consent: For certain marketing communications, optional features, or use of cookies where required. You can withdraw consent at any time, but this will not affect processing already carried out.


3. Security Measures

We use reasonable organisational, technical, and physical safeguards to protect your personal information against:



  • Unauthorised access
  • Unlawful processing
  • Accidental loss, destruction, or damage

These measures may include encryption, secure servers, access controls, firewalls, and regular monitoring.

However, no system is completely secure. While we strive to protect your data, we cannot guarantee absolute security, especially for information transmitted over the internet.


4. Sharing of Information

We may share your personal information with third parties in the following situations:

4.1 Service Providers

We may share your data with trusted third-party service providers that help us operate our online platform and deliver our services, such as:



  • Payment processors and banks
  • Identity verification and fraud-prevention providers
  • Customer support tools and communication platforms
  • Marketing and analytics service providers
  • IT, hosting, and security service providers

These third parties are only allowed to use your information for the specific services they provide to us and must protect it appropriately.


4.2 Legal and Regulatory Compliance

We may disclose your information where required to:



  • Comply with Nigerian laws, regulations, court orders, and lawful requests
  • Respond to regulators, gaming authorities, law enforcement, and other government bodies
  • Enforce our Terms and Conditions and other agreements
  • Protect our rights, property, business, users, or the public
  • Detect, investigate, or prevent fraud, money laundering, or other illegal activities


4.3 Business Transfers

If Ftimerbet is involved in a merger, acquisition, restructuring, or sale of assets, your information may be transferred as part of that transaction. We will take reasonable steps to ensure your personal data remains protected and will notify you where required by law.


5. Your Rights & Choices

5.1 Access and Correction

You have the right to:



  • Access the personal information we hold about you
  • Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data

You can update some of your details directly through your account. For other requests, please contact us using the details in Section 8.


5.2 Deletion and Restriction

Subject to legal and regulatory requirements, you may request that we:



  • Delete your personal information; or
  • Restrict the processing of your personal information

Please note that we may be required by law or regulation to retain certain records for a specified period (for example, transaction records and KYC information).


5.3 Objection & Marketing Preferences

You can:



  • Object to certain processing based on our legitimate interests, where your rights override those interests; and
  • Opt out of receiving marketing or promotional messages at any time, by using the unsubscribe option in our communications or contacting us directly.

Even if you opt out of marketing communications, we may still send you important service or account-related messages (e.g. security alerts, transaction confirmations).


5.4 Cookies and Tracking Technologies

You can manage cookies through your browser or device settings. However, disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality and performance of our website and services.


6. Data Retention

We retain your personal information for as long as:



  • Your Ftimerbet account is active; and/or
  • It is necessary for the purposes described in this Privacy Policy; and/or
  • Required by applicable laws and regulations in Nigeria (including record-keeping for regulatory, tax, anti-money laundering, and dispute resolution purposes).

When we no longer need your data, we will securely delete, anonymise, or archive it in line with our data retention policies and legal obligations.


7. Minors

Our services are strictly for users who are 18 years and above. We do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 18.

If we discover that we have collected personal data from a minor, we will:



  • Immediately close the account; and
  • Delete the related personal information, subject to any legal obligations to retain certain records.

If you believe a minor has used our services, please contact us using the details in Section 8.


8. Contact Us

If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or how we handle your personal information, please contact us:

Email: support@ftimerbet.com

We may ask you to verify your identity before responding to certain requests in order to protect your account and information.


9. Compliance with Nigerian Data Protection Laws

Ftimerbet is committed to complying with applicable Nigerian data protection laws and regulations, including the Nigeria Data Protection Act and guidelines issued by the Nigeria Data Protection Commission (NDPC), as may be amended from time to time.

If you believe your data protection rights have been violated, you may also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Nigeria Data Protection Commission or any other relevant authority. However, we encourage you to contact us first so we can attempt to resolve your concerns.


10. Updates to This Privacy Policy

We may update or modify this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect:



  • Changes in our services or business operations
  • Changes in applicable laws or regulatory requirements
  • Improvements in our privacy practices

Any updates will be posted on our website with the “Last Updated” date. Changes become effective as soon as they are published. We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy regularly to stay informed about how we protect your information.


Last Updated: 27-11-2025

title: Responsible Gaming Policy
content:
Ftimerbet Responsible Gaming Policy

Ftimerbet is committed to promoting Responsible Gaming and ensuring that betting remains a fun and safe form of entertainment for adults in Nigeria. While gambling can be enjoyable, we recognise that it may become problematic for some individuals.

This Responsible Gaming Policy explains the tools, options, and support we provide to help you stay in control of your time and money while using our online betting platform.

1. Our Responsible Gaming Commitment

  • Ftimerbet only accepts customers who are 18 years and above.
  • We encourage betting for entertainment, not as a way to earn a living or solve financial problems.
  • We provide tools and guidance to help you manage your gambling activity and spending.
  • We may take steps (including account restrictions) if we identify harmful or irresponsible gambling behaviour.

2. Safe Gambling Tips

To help you gamble responsibly on Ftimerbet, please consider the following guidelines:

  1. Avoid gambling when upset or depressed
  2. Do not gamble if you are feeling stressed, angry, depressed, or under emotional pressure. Your decision-making may be impaired in such situations.
  3. Keep balance in your life
  4. Gambling should be one of many leisure activities not your only source of entertainment. If gambling becomes your main form of enjoyment, it may be a sign of a problem.
  5. Set financial limits
  6. Decide in advance how much money you can afford to spend per day, week, or month and stick to that limit. Do not increase your limits on impulse.
  7. Take regular breaks
  8. Prolonged gambling sessions can cause you to lose track of time and money. Take regular breaks, step away from your device, go outside, have a meal, or engage in another activity.
  9. Do not chase losses
  10. Losing is part of gambling. Do not try to win back your losses by increasing your stakes. Stick to your pre-set limit and stop when it is reached.
  11. Avoid gambling under the influence
  12. Do not gamble after drinking alcohol or using drugs. These substances can impair your judgment and control, increasing the risk of harmful gambling.
  13. See gambling as entertainment, not income
  14. Treat the money you stake as the cost of entertainment, similar to paying for a movie or event—not as an investment or guaranteed way to make money.
  15. Only gamble with money you can afford to lose
  16. Never use funds meant for rent, school fees, food, medical bills, or other essential expenses for gambling.
  17. Set a money limit in advance
  18. Decide how much you are willing to spend before you start playing. Once you reach that limit, stop. If you win, treat it as a bonus, not a reason to stake more than planned.
  19. Set a time limit
  20. Use a timer or alarm to limit how long you gamble. When the time is up, log out—even if you feel like continuing. The more time you spend gambling, the more you are likely to lose.

3. Gambling Blocking Software

If you feel you need additional help controlling your access to gambling websites, you may consider using gambling blocking software. These tools can:

  • Block access specifically to gambling websites (gambling-specific blockers); or
  • Limit access to selected websites or categories as part of general web filtering or parental controls (general blockers).

Some solutions are free, while others are paid. You should research and choose the option that best suits your needs.

Please note that Ftimerbet is not responsible for the performance, availability, or any issues arising from the use of third-party blocking software.

If you already use such software and still feel you are spending too much time or money on gambling, we strongly encourage you to consider self-exclusion or account closure, as explained below.

4. Self-Exclusion (Stop Gambling Temporarily or Permanently)

If you feel that your gambling has become problematic or you are losing control over your betting behaviour, you can request a self-exclusion from Ftimerbet.

4.1 What Self-Exclusion Means

During a self-exclusion period:

  • You will not be able to place bets or make deposits on your Ftimerbet account.
  • We may allow limited access to view your account history and balance for record and withdrawal purposes only, subject to our controls and policies.
  • You will not receive marketing communications related to promotions or bonuses (as far as technically and operationally possible).

4.2 Types of Self-Exclusion

We may offer:

  • Temporary Self-Exclusion: For a defined period (e.g. 1 month, 3 months, 6 months).
  • Permanent/Indefinite Self-Exclusion: For a longer or indefinite period if you feel you need to stop gambling completely.

For permanent self-exclusion, re-opening your account (if ever allowed) will be subject to strict review, and Ftimerbet reserves the right not to reactivate the account in order to protect you and comply with responsible gaming obligations.

4.3 How to Request Self-Exclusion

You can request self-exclusion by contacting our support team via our official channels (e.g. email or in-platform support). We may ask for verification to ensure that the request is genuine and to protect your account.

Ftimerbet also reserves the right to apply restrictions or self-exclusion measures proactively where we detect signs of harmful gambling behaviour.

5. Closing Your Account

If you believe you are:

  • Spending too much time gambling; or
  • Spending more money than you can afford;

and you wish to stop using Ftimerbet, you may request that your account be closed.

To close your account, please contact our support team. Once closed, you will not be able to place bets or make deposits. Certain information may be retained as required by Nigerian law and regulatory obligations (for example, KYC and transaction records).

If your reason for closure relates to problem gambling, we encourage you to be clear about this in your request so we can consider applying appropriate long-term restrictions.

6. Gambling Support & Therapy Resources

If you feel your gambling is out of control or is negatively affecting your life, we strongly encourage you to seek help.

You may visit online gambling therapy and support websites, which provide:

  • Free practical advice
  • Self-help tools
  • Emotional support for individuals affected by problem gambling
  • Resources for family and friends

While we may provide links or references to external support organisations. You may also seek confidential help and counselling from independent support organisations such as GambleAlert in Nigeria or international resources like GambleAware, which provide information, self-help tools, and professional guidance for anyone affected by problem gambling.

Ftimerbet does not control their services and is not responsible for their content or operation. However, we support and encourage seeking professional help where necessary.

 

7. Protecting Minors and Vulnerable Persons

  • Ftimerbet strictly prohibits under-18s from using our platform.
  • You should keep your login details secure and avoid leaving your device unattended and logged into your account.
  • If you share devices with minors, consider using parental control tools and website blockers to prevent access to gambling sites.

If you become aware that a minor has an account with Ftimerbet, please contact us immediately so we can take prompt action.

8. Contact Us – Responsible Gaming Support

If you have questions about responsible gaming, want more information on our controls, or need help applying any of the measures listed above (limits, self-exclusion, or account closure), please contact us:

Email: support@ftimerbet.com

Our support team will do their best to assist you and guide you towards the most appropriate tools and resources to ensure you gamble safely and responsibly.

title: Terms & Conditions
content:

By registering an account, logging in, placing a bet, depositing funds, withdrawing funds, or using any part of the FTimerbet Platforms, you agree to be bound by these Terms. Any promise, representation or agreement not expressly contained in these Terms is not binding on FTimerbet.

FTimerbet reserves the right to amend these Terms at any time. Updated versions will be published on the FTimerbet Platforms and become effective upon publication. Your continued use of the FTimerbet Platforms after changes take effect constitutes your acceptance of the revised Terms.

FTimerbet’s failure or delay in exercising or enforcing any right under these Terms shall not constitute a waiver of such right. Any leniency granted is at FTimerbet’s discretion and does not prevent us from enforcing our rights strictly at any time in the future.

1.1 Acceptance of Terms

1.1.1 Binding Agreement

These Terms constitute a legally binding agreement between you and FTimerbet. By:

  • creating or maintaining an account;
  • accessing or using the FTimerbet Platforms; or
  • placing any bet or performing any transaction,

you acknowledge that you have read, understood and agreed to be bound by these Terms.

1.1.2 Updates and Version Control

FTimerbet may update, amend or replace these Terms from time to time. The current version will always be available on the FTimerbet Platforms and may indicate the date of last update.

  • Your continued use of the Platforms after any update constitutes your acceptance of the revised Terms.
  • If you do not agree with any updated Terms, you must stop using the FTimerbet Platforms and close your account.

1.1.3 Electronic Acceptance

You agree that:

  • Clicking “Register”, “Sign Up”, “I Agree”, “Place Bet”, “Log in” or similar buttons; or
  • Continuing to use the FTimerbet Platforms

shall constitute your electronic acceptance of these Terms and any product-specific rules, bonus terms or policies referenced herein.

1.2 Eligibility, Registration & Right to Use the Platform

1.2.1 Mode of Operations

FTimerbet operates exclusively online. We do not operate physical betting shops or retail outlets. All betting, deposits, withdrawals and account management are carried out via the FTimerbet Platforms.

1.2.2 Eligibility

To register and use FTimerbet, you must:

  • Be at least 18 years old;
  • Have full legal capacity to enter into binding agreements;
  • Use the FTimerbet Platforms for yourself and on your own behalf (no agents or third-party accounts);
  • Provide accurate, complete and up-to-date personal information when requested (including KYC information such as name, date of birth, address, email, phone, BVN/NIN and bank details).

FTimerbet reserves the right to request documentary proof of identity, age, address and source of funds at any time and to suspend or close accounts where this is not provided or is unsatisfactory.

1.2.3 Account Ownership & Single Account Rule

You may only open one (1) FTimerbet account in your own name. Multiple accounts, impersonation, or using another person’s details is strictly prohibited and may result in account closure, voided bets and withheld funds where fraud or abuse is suspected.

1.3 Deposits, Withdrawals & Pay-outs

1.3.1 Payment Methods

All deposits and withdrawals must be made through approved electronic payment channels, such as:

  • Nigerian bank transfers;
  • Cards issued by Nigerian financial institutions;
  • USSD;
  • Approved local payment gateways and wallets as may be listed on the FTimerbet Platforms.

Cash payments, cheques, credit betting or any unofficial payment arrangements are not allowed.

1.3.2 Currency

All transactions on FTimerbet are conducted in Nigerian Naira (NGN). Any currency conversion fees or charges by your bank or payment provider are your responsibility.

1.3.3 Pay-outs for Winning Bets

Winning bets will be settled as soon as reasonably possible after the official result is confirmed and, in any case, within a maximum of five (5) days, subject to:

  • Completion of any required verification (KYC/AML);
  • Confirmation that there is no obvious error, system malfunction or regulatory breach;
  • Compliance with these Terms and applicable Nigerian law.

FTimerbet reserves the right to withhold or delay payment if we reasonably suspect:

  • Fraud;
  • Money laundering or terrorist financing;
  • Bonus abuse;
  • Match-fixing, collusion or any integrity issue with an event;
  • Technical or human error in odds, settlement or system operation.

1.3.4 Withdrawal Rules

  • Withdrawals may only be made to a Nigerian bank account or permitted wallet in your own name.
  • Maximum withdrawal per day is 5,000,000NGN, while maximum withdrawal per transaction is 2,000,000NGN
  • FTimerbet may, at its discretion, require that withdrawals be made via the same payment method used for deposits.
  • Bonus funds and winnings derived from breach of bonus terms or these Terms may be cancelled or forfeited.

1.4 Minimum Age & Underage Gambling

Under Nigerian law, individuals under 18 years are not permitted to participate in gambling.

  • Any account found to have been created by or on behalf of a minor will be suspended or closed;
  • All bets placed by a minor will be void;
  • No winnings will be paid in respect of underage gambling;
  • FTimerbet may report underage gambling attempts to relevant authorities where required.

FTimerbet may request proof of age at any time and may suspend betting and withdrawals until age verification is completed.

1.5 Account Suspension, Limitation & Closure

FTimerbet may, at its sole discretion and without obligation to provide a reason, refuse to open an account, restrict access, or suspend/close an account, including where:

  • You breach these Terms or any product-specific rules;
  • KYC, AML or responsible gambling checks are not completed satisfactorily;
  • We suspect fraud, money laundering, bonus abuse or other unlawful conduct;
  • You use multiple accounts or misrepresent your identity;
  • You use VPNs, proxies or other methods to disguise your location or circumvent territorial restrictions;
  • You are abusive, threatening, or engage in behaviour that harms FTimerbet’s reputation or operations.

If we close your account for reasons not related to fraud or unlawful activity, any remaining legitimate and withdrawable balance will be paid out to you via an approved method, subject to KYC checks.

Where we reasonably believe that fraud, money laundering, bonus abuse or other unlawful or prohibited activity has occurred, FTimerbet may withhold funds, void bets, and report the matter to law enforcement or relevant regulators.

1.6 Fraudulent, Suspicious & Prohibited Activity

FTimerbet has zero tolerance for fraudulent, abusive or illegal activity. This includes, but is not limited to:

  • Use of false or third-party details to register;
  • Multiple accounts or account sharing;
  • Payment fraud, chargebacks or use of stolen cards/wallets;
  • Collusion, match-fixing, use of inside information;
  • Exploitation of bugs, glitches or obvious pricing errors;
  • Abusing promotions, bonuses or free bets contrary to their intended purpose;
  • Any activity that may expose FTimerbet to regulatory, legal or reputational risk.

In such cases, FTimerbet may:

  • Suspend or close any linked accounts;
  • Void or cancel affected bets;
  • Forfeit bonus funds and associated winnings;
  • Withhold funds where permitted by law;
  • Report your details and activity to relevant authorities, banks, payment providers and regulators in Nigeria.

1.7 Governing Law, Jurisdiction & Territory (Overview)

FTimerbet operates under the laws and regulations of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, including relevant federal and state gaming and tax regulations, and any conditions attached to its licences.

  • All services are intended primarily for customers located in Nigeria.
  • It is your responsibility to ensure that using the FTimerbet Platforms is lawful in your location.
  • FTimerbet does not accept liability for any breach of foreign law where you choose to access our Platforms from outside Nigeria.

These Terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria. Subject to any mandatory regulatory complaint or arbitration processes, any dispute arising from or in connection with these Terms, your account, or any bet shall be submitted to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts in Nigeria, as further detailed in Section 1.16.

1.8 Confidentiality, Data Protection & Security 

FTimerbet is committed to protecting your privacy and handling your personal information in accordance with applicable Nigerian data protection laws, including the Nigeria Data Protection Regulation (NDPR), as amended.

We treat your personal data and betting history as confidential and will only disclose them in line with our legal obligations and our detailed Privacy and Data Usage provisions in Section 1.15.

You are responsible for keeping your login details, password, PIN and any one-time passwords (OTP) confidential. Any action taken using your correct credentials or OTP will be treated as authorised by you.

For full details on how we collect, use, store, share and protect your data, please refer to Section 1.15 – Privacy and Data Usage.

1.9 Use of FTimerbet Platforms

By using the FTimerbet Platforms, you agree not to:

  • Use them for any illegal purpose or in violation of Nigerian law;
  • Upload, share or transmit any content that is abusive, threatening, defamatory, hateful, obscene or otherwise inappropriate;
  • Attempt to hack, attack or disrupt the Platforms or related systems;
  • Use automated tools (bots, scripts, scraping tools) to interact with the Platforms without FTimerbet’s prior written consent;
  • Infringe any intellectual property rights or privacy rights of others;
  • Engage in any activity that may harm FTimerbet’s business, reputation or other customers.

FTimerbet may suspend or terminate access to the Platforms where such misuse is suspected.

To the maximum extent permitted by law, FTimerbet shall not be liable for losses arising from technical failures, interruptions or issues with your own device or internet connection, subject always to the Disclaimers and Limitation of Liability in Section 1.14.

1.10 Third-Party Links & Content

The FTimerbet Platforms may contain links to third-party websites, applications or services. These are provided for convenience only.

  • FTimerbet does not control, endorse or guarantee the content, products or services offered by third parties.
  • You access any third-party site or service at your own risk, and you should review that third party’s terms and privacy policy.

FTimerbet shall not be liable for any loss or damage arising from your use of, or reliance on, third-party content, products or services.

1.11 Responsible Gambling & Brand Protection

FTimerbet supports responsible gambling and reserves the right to:

  • Set limits on stakes, wins or account activity;
  • Restrict participation in promotions;
  • Temporarily or permanently block accounts where gambling behaviour appears harmful or reckless;
  • Provide or refer customers to responsible gambling resources.

We may also decline to offer services or terminate relationships where a customer’s behaviour or activities expose FTimerbet to legal, regulatory, financial or reputational risk in Nigeria.

1.12 Intellectual Property

1.12.1 Ownership

All intellectual property rights in and to the FTimerbet Platforms and all content made available through them (including but not limited to software, code, designs, graphics, logos, trademarks, text, images, audio, video, databases and promotional materials) are owned by FTimerbet or licensed to FTimerbet by third parties. All such rights are reserved.

1.12.2 Limited Licence to Use

FTimerbet grants you a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable licence to access and use the FTimerbet Platforms solely for the purpose of placing bets and using related services in accordance with these Terms. No other use is permitted without our prior written consent.

1.12.3 Restrictions

You agree that you shall not, without FTimerbet’s prior written consent:

  • Copy, reproduce, distribute, modify, adapt, translate or create derivative works from any part of the Platforms or their content;
  • Reverse engineer, decompile, disassemble or attempt to extract source code from any software on the Platforms;
  • Use any FTimerbet trademark, logo or brand element in any manner that may cause confusion or imply endorsement;
  • Use automated tools (bots, crawlers, scrapers) to collect or harvest data from the Platforms, except where explicitly permitted.

Any unauthorised use of FTimerbet’s intellectual property may result in account closure, legal action and/or claims for damages.

1.13 Payment and Refund Policies

1.13.1 Deposits

  • All deposits must be made using approved Nigerian payment methods listed on the FTimerbet Platforms (e.g. local bank transfer, debit/credit cards, USSD, approved wallets and gateways).
  • FTimerbet is not responsible for delays or failures caused by banks, payment providers, network issues, or incorrect details provided by you.

1.13.2 Completed Bets – No Refund

  • Once a bet has been successfully placed and accepted by FTimerbet, it cannot be cancelled or amended by you.
  • Stakes on correctly accepted bets are not refundable, except where FTimerbet, in its sole discretion, voids a bet (e.g. due to an obvious error, event cancellation or regulatory reason).

1.13.3 Mistaken or Duplicate Transactions

If you believe that a deposit or withdrawal has been processed in error or duplicated:

  • You must notify FTimerbet immediately via the official customer support channels;
  • You may be required to provide proof (e.g. screenshots, transaction IDs);
  • FTimerbet will investigate and, where a genuine error is confirmed, we may reverse or correct the transaction, subject to AML and regulatory checks.

1.13.4 Erroneous Credits & Reversals

If any funds, bonus or winnings are credited to your account in error:

  • FTimerbet is entitled to reverse or recover such amounts from your balance;
  • If you have withdrawn funds that were mistakenly credited, you must return them upon request. FTimerbet may take steps (including legal action) to recover such amounts.

1.13.5 Refunds of Balances

  • Where an account is closed by FTimerbet for reasons not involving fraud, AML/CTF breach or serious violation of these Terms, any legitimate, withdrawable balance (excluding bonuses and related winnings) will be paid out to you via an approved method.
  • Where an account is closed due to suspected or confirmed fraud, money laundering, bonus abuse or illegal activity, FTimerbet may withhold funds and report the matter to relevant authorities.

1.14 Disclaimers and Limitation of Liability

1.14.1 No Guarantee of Uninterrupted Service

FTimerbet provides the Platforms and services on an “as is” and “as available” basis. While we will use reasonable efforts to keep the Platforms available and functioning correctly, we do not guarantee that:

  • The Platforms will be uninterrupted, timely, secure or error-free;
  • Defects or errors will always be corrected immediately;
  • The content, odds or information will be free from inaccuracies.

1.14.2 Your Responsibility

You are responsible for:

  • Ensuring that your device, internet connection and software are compatible with the FTimerbet Platforms;
  • Protecting your login details and OTPs;
  • Checking that bets are correct at the time of placement.

1.14.3 Limitation of Liability

To the maximum extent permitted by Nigerian law, FTimerbet, its directors, employees, agents and shareholders shall not be liable for:

  • Any indirect, incidental, special or consequential damages, including loss of profits, revenue, data or goodwill;
  • Any loss arising from:
    • Use or inability to use the Platforms;
    • Delays, interruptions or failures in transmission or communication;
    • Viruses, malware or other harmful code introduced by third parties;
    • Errors or omissions in odds, markets or content (subject to our right to correct/void bets);
    • Misuse of your account due to your failure to keep your credentials secure.

Nothing in these Terms shall exclude or limit FTimerbet’s liability for:

  • Death or personal injury caused by our gross negligence, where such exclusion is prohibited by Nigerian law;
  • Any other liability which cannot be excluded under applicable law.

1.14.4 Maximum Aggregate Liability

Where FTimerbet is found liable to you in relation to a bet or series of bets, our total aggregate liability shall be limited, to the extent permitted by law, to the amount of the stake on the bet(s) in question or the net winnings due (whichever is lower).

1.15 Privacy and Data Usage

1.15.1 Data Protection Compliance

FTimerbet is committed to handling your personal data in accordance with applicable Nigerian data protection laws, including the Nigeria Data Protection Regulation (NDPR), as amended.

 

1.15.2 Data We Collect

We may collect and process information including but not limited to:

  • Identification and contact details (name, date of birth, address, email, phone number, BVN/NIN);
  • Account details and transaction history;
  • Payment and banking details;
  • Device and usage information (IP address, browser type, login times, location approximations);
  • Communication preferences and customer service interactions.

1.15.3 How We Use Your Data

Your data may be used for:

  • Account registration, management and authentication;
  • KYC, AML/CTF checks and regulatory compliance;
  • Processing deposits, withdrawals and bet settlements;
  • Risk management, fraud detection and security monitoring;
  • Providing customer support and service improvements;
  • Sending service-related notifications and, where you consent or law permits, marketing communications.

1.15.4 Sharing of Data

We may share your information with:

  • Regulators, law enforcement or government authorities where required by law;
  • Payment processors, banks and financial institutions for transaction purposes;
  • Service providers acting on our behalf (e.g. IT, hosting, analytics, communication tools) under strict confidentiality obligations;
  • Third parties in the context of a business transfer, merger or reorganisation, where permitted by law.

1.15.5 Data Security & Retention

FTimerbet implements reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorised access, loss or misuse.

We retain your data only for as long as necessary for:

  • The purposes stated above; and
  • Compliance with legal, regulatory and accounting obligations.

1.15.6 Your Rights

Subject to applicable law, you may have rights to:

  • Access the personal data we hold about you;
  • Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data;
  • Request deletion or restriction of processing in certain circumstances;
  • Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent (without affecting prior lawful processing).

Requests can be made through our customer support or any channels specified in our Privacy Policy. We may require verification of your identity before actioning such requests.

1.16 Governing Law and Dispute Resolution

1.16.1 Governing Law

These Terms, and any dispute or claim arising out of or in connection with them, your account, or any bet placed with FTimerbet, shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, without regard to conflict of law principles.

1.16.2 Internal Complaints Procedure

Before taking any formal legal steps, you agree to first contact FTimerbet’s Customer Support to raise your complaint. We will:

  • Acknowledge receipt of your complaint;
  • Investigate the matter;
  • Provide a response within a reasonable time frame.

We may also escalate your complaint internally to our compliance or management team where appropriate.

1.16.3 Regulatory/Escalation Channels

Where required by Nigerian gaming regulations, you may have the right to escalate unresolved disputes to:

  • The relevant regulatory or licensing authority; or
  • Any designated dispute resolution body, if applicable.

Details of such escalation mechanisms may be provided on our Platforms or upon request.

1.16.4 Court Jurisdiction

Subject to any mandatory regulatory processes or agreed alternative dispute resolution mechanisms, any dispute that cannot be resolved amicably shall be submitted to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts in Nigeria.
